title: Milos review return and Pulse snapshots
details: Evia now accepts the current Milos completed-review QR format from either the camera or a saved QR image

Before the review closes the current Coach period, Evia saves a permanent local Review Snapshot of the learner's course position, OTJ or GLH, evidence, usage, EPA practice, confidence and wellbeing check-ins
The review summary, review date, next review date and agreed targets are kept with that snapshot in Evia Pulse review history
The next review date and newly agreed Milos targets then flow into Evia's existing review and target system automatically
No learner name, contact details, signatures or media files are added to the QR exchange
summary: Evia v234 fixes Milos-to-Evia review returns and turns each completed Milos review into a permanent local Pulse Review Snapshot before the next review period begins.
changes: Save a Pulse Review Snapshot before the review period closes
Add Review history to Evia Pulse
Update next review date and agreed targets
